'''Zebulon Dak Speeder Corporation''' was a company founded by [[Zebulon Dak/Legends|Zebulon Dak]] which operated in the early days of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==History==
The corporation was the producer of some of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] fastest [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeders]].
It had a policy dictating that any droid used by an employee must have its memory erased upon induction. When the droids [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] learned that their masters, [[Thall Joben/Legends|Thall Joben]] and his friends, intended to decline an employment offer from the company rather than inflict that, the droids secret stole away to prevent that sacrifice.
